pli-tv-bu-vb-pc37:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc37:1.2: tena kho pana samayena Rājagahe giraggasamajjo hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc37:1.4: manussā sattarasavaggiye bhikkhū passitvā nhāpetvā vilimpetvā bhojetvā khādaniyaṃ adaṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc37:1.5: sattarasavaggiyā bhikkhū khādaniyaṃ ādāya ārāmaṃ gantvā chabbaggiye bhikkhū etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc37:1.7: kuto tumhehi āvuso khādaniyaṃ laddhan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc37:1.8: sattarasavaggiyā bhikkhū chabbaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc37:1.9: kiṃ pana tumhe āvuso vikāle bhojanaṃ bhuñjathā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc37:1.12: kathaṃ hi nāma sattarasavaggiyā bhikkhū vikāle bhojanaṃ bhuñjissantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc37:1.13: atha kho chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc37:1.14: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc37:1.15: kathaṃ hi nāma sattarasavaggiyā bhikkhū vikāle bhojanaṃ bhuñjissantīti. te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc37:1.16: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave vikāle bhojanaṃ bhuñjathā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc37:1.19: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā vikāle bhojanaṃ bhuñjissatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc37:1.20: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc37:1.21: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc37:1.22.1: yo pana bhikkhu vikāle khādaniyaṃ vā bhojaniyaṃ vā khādeyya vā bhuñjeyya vā, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc37:2.2.1: vikāle vikālasaññī khādaniyaṃ vā bhojaniyaṃ vā khādati vā bhuñjati vā, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc37:2.2.4: yāmakālikaṃ sattāhakālikaṃ yāvajīvikaṃ āhāratthāya paṭigaṇhāti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc37:2.3.2: yāmakālikaṃ sattāhakālikaṃ yāvajīvikaṃ sati paccaye paribhuñjati,
